name: Void Purge Force
legend: Whether striking into a warp-compromised vessel to annihilate all aboard, defending a vital Grey Knights warship from infernal threats, or removing allies or foes who know too much, these strike teams of Grey Knights hit hard and fast to ensure none escape their purge.

rules.name: An Urgent Duty
rules.legend: None can be allowed to reach an escape craft or get a distress call away - the purge must be swift and total. This knowledge lends the Grey Knights even greater urgency.
rules.description_html: Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for GREY KNIGHTS units from your army.
rules.description_text: Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for GREY KNIGHTS units from your army.

stratagems.name: HEXBANE WARDS
stratagems.type: Void Purge Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: These unsettling hexagrammatic wards, inscribed on the Grey Knights' wargear before boarding, cause enemy weapons to falter and misfire as machine spirits are banished or tormented to madness.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in that enemy unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

stratagems.name: SANCTIFIED SLAUGHTER
stratagems.type: Void Purge Force – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: With their foes cornered, the Grey Knights’ blades rise and fall, the purge thorough and unmerciful.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Fight phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that charged this turn.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If such a weapon already has that ability, until the end of the phase, each time an attack is made with that weapon, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

stratagems.name: BREACH-SHOCK
stratagems.type: Void Purge Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: So swift and overwhelming is a boarding assault by the Grey Knights that foes are overrun in short order before they even realise their peril.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

stratagems.name: TRANSLOCATION
stratagems.type: Void Purge Force – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Employing single-use microteleportation matrices or focused psychic powers, these Grey Knights step through the warp and back to realspace in an eyeblink.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One INTERcEPTOR SqUAD or GREY KNIGHTS CHARAcTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: The next time your unit is selected to move this phase, models in that unit can move through Walls and closed Hatchways as if they were not there, but when doing so, no model can move more than 6".

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.

enhancements.name: Sigil of Warding
enhancements.legend: This minute silver icon contains a personal teleport matrix and a vigilant machine spirit. Its precogitative psyroutines carefully watch for attacks from a distance, and at the sign of danger it transports its bearer away in a crack of energy.
enhancements.description_html: Once per battle, at the end of your Shooting phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, it can make a Normal move of up to 3" and can then attempt to operate a Hatchway. The bearer is then not eligible to declare a charge this turn.

enhancements.name: Tactical Haruspexy
enhancements.legend: Sanctioned psychic foretelling has determined the future whereabouts of this warrior’s primary target at a precise moment in time. It is a rendezvous only one will survive.
enhancements.description_html: Once per battle, when the bearer declares a charge, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, it can select units that are not visible to it as targets of that charge, provided they are within 9" of it.
